questions.explanation:
## Selector Reliability
getByRole() is more maintainable as it focuses on semantic meaning rather than visual presentation. It survives UI redesigns and internationalization changes.

## Accessibility Benefits
getByRole() ensures your app is screen-reader compatible by testing the same attributes assistive technologies use.

## When to Use Each
- **getByRole()**: Buttons, links, form controls, navigation
- **getByText()**: Error messages, static labels, content validation

## Common Pitfalls
getByText() can match multiple elements or fail with dynamic content. getByRole() requires proper ARIA implementation.

## Performance Considerations
getByRole() is generally faster as it leverages browser accessibility tree, while getByText() requires DOM traversal and text matching.

```javascript
// Good: Semantic interaction
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();

// Good: Content validation
expect(page.getByText('Success!')).toBeVisible();

// Bad: Brittle text selection
await page.getByText('Click here').click(); // Fails if text changes
```

## Why This Is Asked

This checks beginner-friendly E2E testing of a real user flow involving state persistence and offline resilience, a common blind spot for new testers.

## Key Concepts

- End-to-end tests that exercise UI, storage, and API interactions
- Test data seeding for deterministic results
- Handling offline/online state and browser refreshes

## Code Example

```javascript
// Playwright skeleton
test('Save for later persistence', async ({page}) => {
  await page.goto('/home')
  await page.fill('#search','Product X')
  await page.click('text=Add to cart')
  await page.click('text=Move to Save for later')
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.locator('text=Saved for later')).toBeVisible()
  // simulate offline
  await page.context().setOffline(true)
  await page.reload()
  await page.context().setOffline(false)
  await page.click('text=Move to cart')
})
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you adapt this test for mobile vs desktop?
- How would you measure flakiness and improve stability?

## Why This Is Asked

```javascript
// Pseudo-seed function sketch
async function seedTenant(db, tenantId, records){

  await db.records.bulkCreate(records.map(r => ({...r, tenantId})));
}
```
